CTDA.name: Condition
CTDA.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas wbConditions helper record; Comparison Value (float or GLOB FormID, chosen by a Type flag), Parameter #1/#2 (function-dependent) and Reference (FormID or unused, depends on Run On) are xEdit unions of 4-byte alternatives, decoded here as raw u32; Run On/Reference optional per SetOptionalFrom(7); Type is a custom-formatted u8 (comparison operator + flags). [measured: FalloutNV.esm has CTDA of 20, 24 and 28 bytes — the 20-byte form omits both optional fields, the 24-byte form has Run On but not Reference, and the 28-byte form has both; Fallout3.esm has the same three sizes.]
